sources.ref: NCERT CIET audiobook page for Class 1 Joyful Mathematics (chapter list, 13 chapters)

notes: A school class, not an exam: there are no papers or blueprints. The profile follows the NCERT textbook for the 2026-27 session. The textbook is NCERT Class 1 Joyful Mathematics. Its file code is aejm1 (chapter 3: aejm103), inferred from NCERT's file naming; ncert.nic.in failed TLS verification through the proxy on 2026-10-31, so the code and the printed pages could not be checked against the PDF. Facts come from the official CIET audiobook, which reads the textbook page by page; the audio was transcribed for this work and the transcript is kept outside the repo.
